digest.component_or_area: S3 non-create operation coordinator and endpoint-failure fuse
propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must execute atomic desired postconditions in dependency order, preserving successful earlier postconditions and re-observing only remaining drift after partial failure.

Endpoint-scoped fuse must open after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two tickets; provider-scoped fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider; a matching success resets consecutive state.

commit_unknown dispositions are ticket-scoped (never stop sibling tickets/endpoints), projected to the deferred AC6 bucket (never counted as applied or failed), and replay-forbidden to prevent double-apply.

Eligible fuse counter increments only from exhausted_transient and retryable_deferred dispositions arising at RetryBudget caps (MAX_INVOCATIONS or MAX_CUMULATIVE_SLEEP_MS); physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, and opaque diagnostics are excluded.

When a fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer explicitly with reason, scope, and retry_not_before metadata; independent scopes continue and exact applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies are preserved.
